verification.summary: Passed 9/9 in approximately 6.3 minutes with one worker and zero retries, on approval 2026-08-14-country-gate-parity-redirect-2. A4 proved one Bancontact EUR checkout sent the provider method bancontact with the run-owned return URL and settled one succeeded intent with one captured charge. A4p proved card-testing protection admitted the token-bearing Bancontact checkout to the same settled graph while the tokenless submission created no provider object. The lock directory ended with zero quarantine receipts and zero unresolved provider-write attempts, and enabled payment methods were restored to the original card-only set. This packet closes only A4 and A4p; the family's other cases are outside this packet.

Passed 9/9 in 7.1 minutes with one worker and zero retries, on approval 2026-08-20-body-dependency-removal-2. This is the run that closes the six rows added here: Alipay on the shortcode and block-based surfaces, and Affirm and Cash App Afterpay each under card-testing protection off and on. The two Bancontact rows closed earlier in this packet on their own 9/9 run. The run also exercised the removal of the drivers dependence on the checkout response body: order identity now comes from the store order delta, so the Blocks Alipay case no longer fails when a navigation frees the response buffer before Chromium can answer for it. Lock directory ended with zero quarantine receipts and zero unresolved provider write attempts.
